glossary.definition: Entertainment A/V sources sharing the same Source Control events: External CD, HU AUX, HU USB, HU BTSA (CFTS025 §3.1.1.3.1)
Seek Up/Down, FF/RW, Play/Pause, Browse/List, Shuffle, Repeat — apply across all Player subgroup sources
Default mode: play whole 'Now Playing' playlist, loop to start after last. 'repeat' softkey shown in OFF state
Repeat the currently playing item. 'repeat' softkey shown in ON state. Toggled from Repeat All via the same softkey
On = play playlist in randomized sequence; Off = normal sequence (CFTS025 §3.1.1.4.2.8)
Go to next file, wrap-around to first; in Random mode regenerates random list (§3.1.1.4.2.1)
Go to current or previous track/file (§4.1.5.1.2)

feature_model.normal: toggles playback; Pause softkey shown while playing
feature_model.abnormal: no media / no supported files -> control unavailable

feature_model.normal: toggle Repeat All <-> Repeat One Track via 'repeat' softkey
feature_model.boundary: EXACTLY TWO states (All, One Track). There is NO 'No Repeat/Off' mode

feature_model.normal: toggle On/Off; On randomizes Now Playing playlist
Seek Up=next (wrap to first), Seek Down=prev/current
feature_model.abnormal: unreadable file -> auto skip forward to next readable (PU0024)
no supported files -> PU0003; disc/USB read error -> PU0005 '(Device Name) error'; unreadable track -> PU0024 auto-skip
feature_model.boundary: format list per CFTS 'Disc Media' section

interactions.rule: All are Source Control events; identical behaviour expected across External CD / HU AUX / HU USB / HU BTSA — sibling TCs per source
In Random (Shuffle On) mode, Seek Up regenerates a new random list

boundaries.name: Media error Pop Ups
enum: PU0003 Media file not found (no supported files)
PU0024 file not readable -> auto skip

boundaries.name: Unsupported-file handling
enum: Generic 'No Supported Files Found' (PU0003) only — NO per-format enumeration in spec
boundaries.source: CFTS025 §3.1.1.2.4.2 (confirmed at Gate ①: no format list)

traceability_hints.spec_ref: §3.1.1.2.4.2 No Supported Files Found Error -> PU0003
§3.1.1.3.1 Source Control events (full Play Controls list)

open_questions.question: Confirm Repeat has NO 'Off/No Repeat' state — spec defines only Repeat All <-> Repeat One Track. (Reviewer earlier hallucinated a 'No Repeat' mode.)
open_questions.resolution: Confirmed: Repeat has ONLY Repeat All <-> Repeat One Track. No 'Off/No Repeat' state.

open_questions.question: Supported media file-format list — defined in CFTS 'Disc Media' section, not in this doc. Need that list to enumerate unsupported-format negative TCs.
open_questions.resolution: No enumerated format list exists. Unsupported handling is the SINGLE generic 'No Supported Files Found' error (PU0003). Do NOT enumerate per-format negative TCs (.exe/.apk/etc.) — over-reach beyond spec.
